_about: Remaps from codes MEDSL uses to the county FIPS codes in the us-atlas map. Loaded by normalize/president.ts. Keys are '<state postal>:<MEDSL code, zero-padded to 5 digits>' so a remap can never move votes into another state. Each entry says why. States with no county results at all are listed in packages/shared/data/no-county-layer.json.

SD:46113.why: Shannon County, SD was renamed Oglala Lakota County in 2015 and given a new code.

VA:51515.why: Bedford city, VA merged into Bedford County in 2013.

MO:2938000.why: Kansas City, MO reports separately from Jackson County (2016, 2020 code). Its votes are cast in Jackson County, and the map has no separate Kansas City shape.

MO:36000.why: MEDSL's 2024 file codes Kansas City, MO as 36000 (a New York-prefixed code). Same fix as MO:2938000.
